airport: An airport features expansive smooth gray runways with clear white markings, large terminal buildings, and extensive aprons with parked aircraft, distinguishing it from the parallel linear railway tracks of railway stations, the dense rectangular factory buildings of industrial areas, and the dense medium-to-large flat-roofed building clusters of commercial areas.
bareland: Bareland presents a broad, flat expanse of uniform light brown or tan soil with a smooth fine-grained texture and no visible vegetation or structures, distinguishing it from the vast uniform pale yellow sand with subtle wind-formed ripple textures of desert, the rugged irregular topography with varied rock tones of mountain, and the flat gray paved surfaces of industrial zones.
baseballfield: A baseball field displays a distinctive fan-shaped green outfield with a diamond-shaped dirt infield and a circular arc boundary, distinguishing it from the large oval or rectangular enclosed structures with tiered seating of stadiums, the open green lawns with scattered trees of park, and the small rectangular colorful surfaces with sports court markings of playground.
beach: A beach appears as a broad, smooth expanse of fine light tan sand with a gentle natural transition to water and subtle wave patterns along the shoreline, distinguishing it from the sinuous naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water of river, the vast uniform pale yellow sand with wind-formed ripple textures of desert, and the developed shoreline with low-rise buildings and swimming pools of resort.
bridge: A bridge appears as a linear elevated structure crossing perpendicularly over a dark water body with visible support pillars and shadow patterns on the water surface below, distinguishing it from the long continuous elevated linear concrete structure with regular support pillars casting rhythmic shadow patterns of viaduct, the enclosed still dark smooth water of pond, and the large rectangular factory buildings with flat rooftops of industrial.
center: An urban center displays a dense cluster of tall, varied-size rectangular buildings with complex rooftop structures, narrow street grids, and minimal green space, distinguishing it from the large oval or rectangular enclosed structures with tiered seating of stadium, the distinctive rectangular buildings with prominent tall steeples or spires of church, and the dense medium-to-large flat-roofed building clusters of commercial.
church: A church features a distinctive rectangular building with a prominent tall steeple or spire, often with a cross-shaped floor plan visible from above, surrounded by small parking areas and open space, distinguishing it from the dense cluster of tall varied-size buildings of center, the large flat gray paved surfaces with parking lines of parking, and the large rectangular main buildings with adjacent playgrounds of school.
commercial: Commercial areas display dense clusters of medium-to-large rectangular buildings with flat rooftops, extensive paved parking lots between structures, and regular street grids, distinguishing them from the dense tall varied-size building clusters of center, the large rectangular factory buildings with storage tanks of industrial, and the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular parking grids of parking.
denseresidential: Dense residential areas show tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing, narrow streets, and very limited green space between buildings, distinguishing them from the moderately spaced houses with visible yards and regular street grids of mediumresidential, the widely scattered individual houses with abundant vegetation of sparseresidential, and the large rectangular factory buildings with flat rooftops of industrial.
desert: A desert presents a vast, uniform expanse of light tan or pale yellow sand with subtle wind-formed ripple textures and no vegetation, distinguishing it from the broad flat expanse of uniform light brown soil of bareland, the continuous dark green canopy with clumpy texture of forest, and the broad smooth expanse of fine light tan sand with water transition of beach.
farmland: Farmland displays large, regularly gridded patches of crops with distinct linear row patterns, alternating color bands of green and brown, and clear geometric field boundaries, distinguishing it from the broad uniform expanse of bright green grass of meadow, the flat gray paved surfaces and factory buildings of industrial, and the enclosed still dark smooth water of pond.
forest: A forest exhibits a dense, continuous dark green canopy with a fine-grained rough clumpy texture showing no geometric structure or regular pattern, distinguishing it from the rugged irregular topography with varied rock tones and elevation changes of mountain, the enclosed still dark smooth water of pond, and the broad uniform expanse of bright green grass of meadow.
industrial: Industrial areas display large rectangular factory buildings with flat rooftops, clusters of circular storage tanks, wide internal roads, and minimal vegetation, distinguishing them from the large flat gray paved surfaces with parking lines of parking, the dense medium-to-large flat-roofed building clusters of commercial, and the expansive smooth gray runways with terminal buildings of airport.
meadow: A meadow presents a broad, uniform expanse of bright green grass with a smooth fine texture and no visible geometric patterns, markings, or structures, distinguishing it from the large regularly gridded patches of crop rows of farmland, the enclosed still dark smooth water of pond, and the small rectangular colorful surfaces with sports court markings of playground.
mediumresidential: Medium residential areas feature moderately spaced single-family houses with visible yards, a regular street grid, and a balanced mix of rooftops and green space, distinguishing them from the tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing of denseresidential, the widely scattered individual houses with large gaps of sparseresidential, and the developed shoreline with low-rise buildings and swimming pools of resort.
mountain: Mountain terrain displays rugged, irregular topography with varied tones of rock and sparse vegetation, showing natural contour patterns and shadow variations from elevation changes, distinguishing it from the dense continuous dark green canopy of forest, the broad flat expanse of uniform light brown soil of bareland, and the vast uniform pale yellow sand of desert.
park: A park features large open green lawns with scattered trees, winding paths, and possibly small ponds or recreational facilities, distinguishing it from the enclosed still dark smooth water of pond, the large flat paved or semi-paved rectangular areas of square, and the fan-shaped green outfield with diamond-shaped dirt infield of baseballfield.
parking: A parking lot presents a large flat gray paved surface with a regular grid of thin white parking space lines and scattered small dark vehicle rectangles, distinguishing it from the dense medium-to-large flat-roofed building clusters of commercial, the complex water boundaries with linear dock structures and moored ships of port, and the large rectangular factory buildings with storage tanks of industrial.
playground: A playground displays small rectangular or irregularly shaped colorful surfaces with visible sports court markings, running tracks, or play equipment shadows, often adjacent to school buildings, distinguishing it from the large rectangular main buildings with adjacent green yards of school, the large oval or rectangular enclosed structures with tiered seating of stadium, and the broad uniform expanse of bright green grass of meadow.
pond: A pond appears as a small, enclosed, roughly circular or irregular dark smooth water body surrounded by land with a clear defined shoreline, distinguishing it from the open green lawns with scattered trees of park, the sinuous naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water of river, and the broad uniform expanse of bright green grass of meadow.
port: A port contains complex water boundaries with linear dock structures, moored ships appearing as large bright elongated objects, cranes, and extensive paved storage areas, distinguishing it from the developed shoreline with low-rise buildings and swimming pools of resort, the expansive smooth gray runways with terminal buildings of airport, and the large flat gray paved surfaces with parking lines of parking.
railwaystation: A railway station features multiple parallel linear railway tracks with platforms, adjacent station buildings, and surrounding structures, distinguishing it from the large rectangular factory buildings and storage tanks of industrial, the expansive smooth gray runways with terminal buildings of airport, and the long continuous elevated linear concrete structure of viaduct.
resort: A resort displays a mix of low-rise buildings with swimming pools, landscaped green areas, and proximity to water bodies or beaches, with a relaxed layout and abundant recreational facilities, distinguishing it from the broad smooth expanse of fine light tan sand of beach, the enclosed still dark smooth water of pond, and the moderately spaced houses with visible yards of mediumresidential.
river: A river appears as a sinuous, naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water with irregular banks and variable width flowing through the landscape, distinguishing it from the small enclosed roughly circular dark smooth water of pond, the dense continuous dark green canopy of forest, and the broad smooth expanse of fine light tan sand of beach.
school: A school features a large rectangular main building with adjacent rectangular playgrounds or sports courts, open green yards, and surrounding parking areas, distinguishing it from the small colorful surfaces with sports court markings of playground, the large flat gray paved surfaces with parking lines of parking, and the open green lawns with scattered trees of park.
sparseresidential: Sparse residential areas show widely scattered individual houses with abundant surrounding vegetation and large gaps between structures, distinguishing them from the tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing of denseresidential, the moderately spaced houses with visible yards and regular street grids of mediumresidential, and the continuous dark green canopy with clumpy texture of forest.
square: A square appears as a large, open, flat paved or semi-paved rectangular area surrounded by buildings, with minimal vegetation and clear geometric boundaries, distinguishing it from the open green lawns with scattered trees and winding paths of park, the dense cluster of tall varied-size buildings of center, and the large flat gray paved surfaces with parking lines of parking.
stadium: A stadium displays a large oval or rectangular enclosed structure with tiered seating visible as concentric rings, a central green field, and surrounding parking areas, distinguishing it from the fan-shaped green outfield with diamond-shaped dirt infield of baseballfield, the dense cluster of tall varied-size buildings of center, and the small colorful surfaces with sports court markings of playground.
storagetanks: Storage tanks appear as a cluster of perfectly circular, uniform-sized bright metallic or white cylindrical structures with consistent shadows, typically located within industrial areas, distinguishing them from the large rectangular factory buildings of industrial, the enclosed still dark smooth water of pond, and the dense cluster of tall varied-size buildings of center.
viaduct: A viaduct appears as a long, elevated linear concrete structure with regular support pillars crossing over terrain or roads and casting rhythmic shadow patterns, distinguishing it from the linear water-crossing structure with visible support pillars of bridge, the large flat gray paved surfaces with parking lines of parking, and the multiple parallel linear railway tracks of railwaystation.
